summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 4 new requirements verified end-to-end. Backend: 48/48 regression tests (test_pinjamku_flow.py) + 22/22 new iteration-2 tests (test_iter2_features.py) = 70/70 PASSING on public URL. Frontend: force-password gating, superadmin-override-box visibility (superadmin YES, admin NO), override-verify/reject dialogs with reason input, reset-password-dialog + temp-password-dialog on /users, reset-borrower-password-dialog on /borrowers/{id} — all data-testid attributes present and flows work end-to-end.

issues: Dialog content background is slightly translucent; the underlying page text (e.g. 'AKTIF' badge, 'DIVERIFIKASI OLEH') bleeds through the dialog body making the confirmation copy slightly harder to read. Cosmetic — increase DialogContent bg-opacity to fully opaque background (bg-background instead of translucent).

action_items: (Optional design polish) Make DialogContent backgrounds fully opaque so underlying page content does not bleed through modals.
critical_code_review_comments: core.normalize_phone canonicalises correctly for 08xxx / 62xxx / +62xxx / 0062xxx and login/register/create-user all use it consistently; startup normalize_existing_phones ensures legacy rows migrate. Solid.

loan_routes.override_payment enforces require_roles(ROLE_SUPERADMIN), rejects action != verify/reject, requires reason >=10 chars via Pydantic (returns 422), returns 409 when payment not PENDING, updates audit_logs with SUPERADMIN_PAYMENT_OVERRIDE_VERIFY|REJECT and loan_status_histories with 'OVERRIDE SUPERADMIN' reason. Reject correctly re-derives ACTIVE vs OVERDUE based on due_date. Borrower can submit a new payment attempt after override reject. All verified.

admin_routes.reset_password: Admin can only reset borrowers (403 for lender/admin targets), superadmin cannot reset self (400), borrower/lender cannot call (403 via require_staff). Temporary password generated by generate_temp_password (Pk + 8 alnum + !) and must_change_password=True set atomically. Well-scoped.

core.get_current_user gates non-allowlist paths with 403 when must_change_password=True; PASSWORD_CHANGE_ALLOWED_PATHS covers /api/auth/me, /api/auth/password, /api/auth/logout, /api/public/settings — matches spec. change_password clears the flag. Verified via GET /api/dashboard, /api/loans, POST /api/loans all returning 403 while temp password is active.

storage.save_upload uploads to Emergent object storage under 'pinjamku/{kind}/{user_id}/{uuid}.{ext}' with MIME whitelist (jpg/png/webp/pdf) and 5MB cap; text/plain and .exe rejected 400. GET /api/files/{id} returns 401 unauth, 403 for unrelated borrower, 200 with 'Cache-Control: private, no-store' for authorised viewers. All verified.

Regression: RBAC unchanged — Admin still 403 on POST /api/payments/{id}/verify; lender A cannot verify lender B's payment; borrower cannot claim/approve. late_days now stable at exactly 3 days (fixed per iteration-1 note).

Small nit: loan_routes.override_payment persists override_by/override_reason on the loan for VERIFY branch only; the REJECT branch stores override/override_reason on the payment doc only (not on loan). If auditing wants a permanent 'this loan was reject-overridden' marker on the loan itself, consider mirroring.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 4 new UI flows (force-password page, override box visibility per role, override dialogs, reset-password dialogs on /users and /borrowers/:id)

test_credentials: Superadmin 081200000001 / Sup3rAdmin!2026. Admin/Pendana/Peminjam are created dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates: 1 Admin + 1 Pendana + 1 Borrower for iter2, plus loans reaching WAITING_PAYMENT_VERIFICATION for override verify + override reject scenarios. All records prefixed with 'TEST' or 'UI Test' and use randomised phone/email/NIK so runs stay idempotent. No cleanup fixture — mirrors iteration 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both test files must run with `-n 0` because /app/backend/pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope and these suites share module-level STATE. Command: `pytest backend/tests/test_pinjamku_flow.py backend/tests/test_iter2_features.py -v -n 0`. Total ~27s. The iteration-2 file exercises loan_status_histories collection (via LS.record_status) — do not rename that collection. Emergent object storage prefix is 'pinjamku/' and MIME whitelist is jpg/png/webp/pdf only.
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bug in this iteration. Two self-inflicted test bugs during authoring were fixed in-place: (1) idempotency window (20s) rejected a second identical loan submission — resolved by using different principal amounts across override scenarios; (2) account_holder min_length=2 rejected 'T' — resolved by using 'TT'.
